issues.description: The problem statement (UML) and the template define Farm.singFarmSong() and singFarmSongVerse(Animal) as void methods that print the song, but the solution implementation changes these to return String (singFarmSong(): String and singFarmSongVerse(Animal): String). This return-type change between the specification/template and the solution is a structural mismatch that can confuse students about the required API and expected behavior (printing vs returning) and may cause them to misinterpret the intended design or the reference implementation.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the API across artifacts. Either (A) change the solution to match the UML/template by making singFarmSong() and singFarmSongVerse(Animal) have a void return type and perform printing (System.out.println), or (B) update the problem statement UML and the template signatures to return String (and document that singFarmSong() returns the full song text rather than printing). Prefer option (A) to preserve the stated requirement that the method prints the song.
